content.learning_goal: Teach the central ideas of The Wonderful World of Science accurately and accessibly.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Activate prior knowledge and invite a prediction.

explanation_sections.title: Explain
explanation_sections.explanation: Build understanding from the source-grounded evidence.
source_evidence: We start exploring our surroundings and asking questions right from our childhood.
Did you enjoy discovering and exploring the world around you in the Preparatory Stage of school?
As you enter the Middle Stage, we will continue this fascinating journey, trying to explore and understand the beautiful world we live in.
Science is a way of thinking, observing and What is doing things to understand the world we live in Science?

explanation_sections.title: Apply
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from a chapter example to a new related situation.

explanation_sections.title: Close
explanation_sections.explanation: Retrieve the central idea and supporting reasoning.
